newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT-Xerox buyback on hold on Rank deal.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-Xerox buyback on hold on Rank deal.

text.p: Xerox Corp said it would suspend its share buyback as a result of the Rank Xerox deal. The company said it would revisit the share buyback program in the future. A full text of the company's press release follows.
-------------------------Press Release------------------------ Xerox to Acquire Remaining Interest in Rank Xerox from the Rank Group

STAMFORD, Conn., June 6 /PRNewswire/ -- Xerox Corporation (NYSE: XRX) and The Rank Group plc today announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding for Xerox to acquire The Rank Group's remaining 20 percent financial interest in Rank Xerox for 940 million, or approximately $1.5 billion. In February 1995, Xerox acquired a portion of the Rank Group's financial interest in Rank Xerox, which increased the Xerox financial interest in Rank Xerox from 67 percent to 80 percent.

Under terms of the memorandum, Xerox will pay Rank Group 500 million in cash at closing. The balance will be paid in deferred installments, half within one year and the other half at the end of two years. An additional payment of up to 60 million would be made in 2000 based upon achievement of significant Rank Xerox earnings growth targets by 1999.

"This is an excellent move for Xerox and Xerox shareholders. Our purchase of the remaining interest in Rank Xerox enhances shareholder value and improves earnings by expanding our economic presence in the global document processing market," said Xerox Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Paul A. Allaire.
Rank Xerox will be known as "Xerox Limited" once the transaction is completed.
Also, as a result of this transaction, Xerox announced it is suspending its share repurchase program.

"Use of the company's financial resources to fund this $1.5 billion transaction produces greater value to Xerox shareholders than continuing the current share repurchase program. However, we will revisit the share repurchase program in the future," Allaire said.

The signing of the memorandum of understanding has been approved by the boards of directors of Xerox and The Rank Group. It is anticipated that the transaction will close in late June, subject to the signing of definitive agreements and customary closing conditions. The transaction must also be approved by Rank Group shareholders.

Rank Xerox, with headquarters in Marlow, England, manufactures Xerox products, systems and supplies, and markets them in more than 80 countries in Europe, Asia and Africa and owns a 50 percent interest in Fuji Xerox. Rank Xerox was formed in 1956 as a joint venture between Xerox and The Rank Organisation.
Xerox has its corporate headquarters in Stamford, Conn. The Rank Group, a leisure and entertainment company, is based in London.
